name: serial-console-mcp
description: By Stefan Brunner. Let Claude work any device through its serial console: Juniper and Cisco routers and switches, IoT gateways, alarm and control panels, instruments and microcontrollers, and CAT and CI-V radios and antenna rotators, in raw, ANSI or VT100 mode.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Refuse anything but read-style commands (show, display, get, CAT and CI-V reads) and refuse DTR and RTS changes.

idle_minutes.title: Close an idle port after (minutes)
idle_minutes.description: Free a port nobody has used for this long, so a forgotten connection stops blocking other programs. 0 disables it.
